query: SELECT c.series_id, (1 - c.distance)::float8 AS "score!" FROM ( SELECT series_id, embedding <=> $1::text::halfvec(128) AS distance FROM series_embedding ORDER BY embedding <=> $1::text::halfvec(128) LIMIT $5 ) c JOIN series_prior p ON p.series_id = c.series_id AND p.recommendable JOIN series s ON s.id = c.series_id AND (NOT s.adult_gated OR $3) WHERE c.series_id <> $2 ORDER BY c.distance LIMIT $4
